scope: Independent fidelity QA of frozen Stan2k results, diagnostic02, five-row JAGS/Stan comparison, Markdown and four-page PDF v1; includes separately accepted representation repair.
meaning: PASS certifies correspondence and preservation of the scoped artifacts. The empirical result remains computationally_inconclusive; posterior precision, equivalence, scientific validity, production and historical gates are not approved.

checks.CSV_RDS: Four CSV files checked separately, with 2000 warmup plus 2000 retained rows each. Every original draw and sampler column compared to its retained CSV rows, respecting chain IDs 1:4. Maximum absolute read-back difference 7.275957614183426e-12.
checks.settings: Seed 1001261, chain IDs 1:4, thin 1, saved warmup, adapt_delta .99, max_depth 12, one thread per serial chain and frozen per-chain initialization paths confirmed.
checks.global_reconstruction: Own R implementation, not candidate adapter: all 23 targets from original Stan names; mu reconstructed from alpha, b0, sqrt(v)*z; joint M/S use the same Z for each unit/draw. Rank-normalized Rhat, bulk/tail ESS, MCSE, summaries and four chain means recomputed with posterior 1.7.0.
checks.class_checks: 429 indicator means/ranges and three class counts reconstructed from raw Z. All mandatory decisions use strict Rhat<1.01, bulk/tail ESS>=400 and class range<=.05; counts use divisor 143. No NA approval or empirical analytic-constant exemption.
checks.RB: M_RB and S_RB reconstructed separately using stored conditional responsibilities; their diagnostics remain secondary and do not replace mandatory same-Z functionals.
checks.comparison: All four reviewed JAGS timing rows, 92 JAGS global rows and 18 JAGS groups unchanged. Five-row comparison, 23 D_Stan-D_JAGS20k differences, combined MCSE=sqrt(MCSE_Stan^2+MCSE_JAGS^2), ESS-per-second denominators and aggregates checked independently. MCSE-standardized differences remain descriptive, not equivalence tests.
checks.JAGS_A_D_sources_preserved: Current sources and both old/new consumed copies match the previously reviewed A/D SHA256 values; no historical raw study was rerun.
checks.Markdown_numeric_tables: All 25 data rows across five tables checked, plus group summaries and interpretation read against retained results.
checks.PDF_visual: All four pages inspected; Table 5 continues with repeated headers on page 4. No clipping, lost rows, misalignment or numerical discrepancy found. All 25 Markdown numeric rows also located in extracted PDF text.

timing.Stan_compile_scope: CmdStan executable plus C++ density/gradient model-method interface, as recorded in the frozen preparation.

checker_resolution.issue: The review helper initially attempted numeric coercion of the literal CmdStan save_warmup=true token.
checker_resolution.resolution: Explicit true/false conversion in the reviewer helper; corrected full run completed in attempt02. All prior logs retained. No candidate, data, threshold or statistical decision changed.

limitations.detail: All 1742 mandatory decisions were reapplied, but local-continuous and individual-indicator Rhat/ESS were not exhaustively recalculated. Raw class means/ranges, all 23 globals, all 860 internals and three class-count metrics were independently recomputed.
JAGS numerical QA is reused from its hash-bound independent review and small reviewed tables. JAGS raw chains were not loaded again, and historical inventory was not reopened.
Compiled target fidelity and model derivation rely on the bound preflight review plus source preservation; no new compilation or mathematical identification audit was performed.

HMC success does not establish posterior precision. Global and local failures persist alongside rare/discrete-class failures. The engine difference/MCSE ratios cannot establish equivalence or reliable electoral quantities.
Recorded productive wall time excludes the disclosed failed diagnostic and development/QA. It is not all-in project time or a controlled estimate of prospective parallel-chain performance.
The PASS is bound to the supplied 45-file candidate and its explicit dependencies. It is not a blanket audit of every historical artifact or authorization for production/gates.
